Source: invented owner-authored-style statement for evaluation only; not an actual owner preference.
Tôi ưu tiên giữ dữ liệu cục bộ làm mặc định; không gửi ra ngoài trong mỗi truy vấn.

This synthetic example is not a provider setting or real consent.

# Synthetic action-effect observation
Synthetic observation: With cache enabled, median wait was 93 ms; with cache disabled, 120 ms across twelve synthetic trials.
This observation does not establish causality and is not evidence that caching alone caused the difference.
